_comment: Marketplace plugins deliberately NOT shown as cards on docs/index.html (card IMjjDwAS). Each entry is plugin name -> the reason it is hidden. They stay installable from the marketplace. scripts/check-catalogue-matches-marketplace.py fails on a stale entry (name no longer in marketplace.json) or an entry that also has a card.

hidden.linkedin-scraper: Scraping LinkedIn profiles conflicts with LinkedIn's User Agreement, so it stays installable but is not headlined on the public catalogue page.
hidden.rtl-chat: Duplicates rtl-chat-fixer, which already has a card (one card per user job); it is v0.1.0 and has no README.md for a docs link.
